description: Add API routing and token authentication (Sanctum) to the app

examples.description: Create model with all related files

name: php artisan tinker
description: Interact with your application via REPL
notes: Test code interactively
Access models, helpers, and application features
Exit with 'exit' or Ctrl+C

name: php artisan optimize
description: Cache configuration and routes for better performance
notes: Run before deploying to production
Use optimize:clear to clear all caches
In Laravel 11+ optimize caches config, events, routes and views; optimize:clear clears them all

name: php artisan queue:work
description: Start processing jobs on the queue

Max seconds a job may run

Exit once the queue is empty

queue:listen reloads code for every job; handy locally but slower
Run workers under Supervisor (or use Horizon for Redis queues) in production

notes: WARNING: Drops ALL tables, including non-migration tables

name: php artisan db:table

name: php artisan model:show
description: Show information about an Eloquent model

notes: Shows attributes, relations, observers, etc.

notes: Improves performance in production

notes: Shows task, schedule, and next run time

name: php artisan schedule:run
notes: Typically run via cron every minute
Laravel determines which tasks should run

description: Run the scheduler in the foreground every minute (local development)

name: php artisan queue:flush
notes: Permanently removes failed jobs
Cannot be undone

name: php artisan queue:restart
description: Gracefully restart queue workers after their current job

examples.description: Signal all workers to restart (run on every deploy)

notes: Uses the cache to signal workers, so a shared cache driver is required across servers

name: php artisan telescope:install

name: php artisan pulse:install

name: php artisan sail:publish
